headlines.title: NFLX Stock Drops Over 14% This Month, Nears This Crucial Level From July — Here’s A Look At Some Key Street Takes
headlines.summary: Post a weak September, Netflix shares have moved closer to the $65 area tested during July’s post-earnings sell-off; analysts remain divided over weaker engagement and the streamer’s broad consumer reach.

headlines.title: Netflix Analysts Are Souring on the Stock as Growth Fears Mount
headlines.summary: Netflix Inc.’s bullish support on Wall Street is starting to crack with the stock on pace for its worst year since 2022 amid rising concerns about growth.

headlines.title: What's Wrong With Netflix Stock?
headlines.summary: Despite double-digit revenue growth, the stock has struggled to rebound.

headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Falls More Steeply Than Broader Market: What Investors Need to Know
headlines.summary: In the latest trading session, Netflix (NFLX) closed at $69.23, marking a -2.69% move from the previous day.

headlines.title: Down 46%, is Netflix a buy now?
headlines.summary: The beaten-down streaming giant trades at 22 times earnings near a 52-week low, with 25 of 33 analysts still saying buy.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
